# indra.recognition.v1

*Engine · recognition · package `linecaster-indra`*

linecaster engine for the recognition step: Indra OCR (Datalab's ONNX pipeline of detector, orientation,
script classifier, line recognizers, layout and reading order) on the whole page, on the CPU, from the page
image's file (`image_input = "bytes"`). Returns the page's Markdown as a text-only transcription; the models are
`weights` (the catalog pin), else the package's own model set.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Class | `linecaster_indra:IndraRecognitionEngine` |
| Source | [recognizer.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/engines/indra/src/linecaster_indra/recognizer.py) |
| Reads | pages |
| Produces | lines, text, markdown |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `Literal['auto', 'ocr', 'text']` | `'auto'` | the package's mode: auto (an image is OCR'd; a PDF uses its text layer where it has one), ocr, text |
| `furniture` | `bool` | `False` | keep page headers and footers in the Markdown |
| `math` | `bool` | `False` | write math as LaTeX (the math models; slower) |
| `dpi` | `float` | `200.0` | the resolution PDF pages are rendered at (images are read as they are) |
| `threads` | `int` | `1` | ONNX Runtime threads (one per task, as the package's own workers) |
